rules.name: Office hours
rules.exception_text: The person on call tonight may sign in at any hour.
rules.why: Staff work in the day, so a sign-in in the middle of the night is unusual.

rules.name: Company computers
rules.text: Only computers on the company list may sign in.
details: Every company computer is named after its owner, like Ben's computer or Dana's laptop. The Floor 2 printer is shared and is also on the list.
rules.why: A computer the company does not know could belong to anyone.
rules.broken: came from a computer that is not on the company list

rules.name: Sign-in place
rules.why: Staff sign in at work. Another country can mean someone else has the password.
